description: This file contains JavaScript code for form features in Drupal, including event triggers, form summary management, preventing duplicate submissions, populating user info from browser, and handling URL fragment interactions.

methods.name: drupalGetSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the summary text for the first form element based on a callback.

methods.name: drupalSetSummary
methods.description: Sets a summary callback for form elements and triggers summary updates on form updates.

methods.name: formSingleSubmit
methods.description: Behavior that prevents multiple identical form submissions by serializing form data.

methods.name: fillUserInfoFromBrowser
methods.description: Behavior that prepopulates form fields with user info stored in local storage and saves updates on form submit.

methods.name: formFragmentLinkClickOrHashChange
methods.description: Handles URL hash changes and fragment link clicks, triggers events, and focuses target elements.
